notes.title: It's Time To Rustle!
notes.notes:
After a longer than expected time in Early Access, the team is excited to announce that Dungeon Rustlers is now released. 

50 palm-moistening levels.
Global leader boards.
23 bumpin' tunes.
3 player classes.

Just.
Don't.
Die.

Those of you who have been long-time testers of the game will enjoy 10 *brand new* original tracks from our composer: Dmitry Zhbanov. Your foot will be tapping - albeit not as fast as your fingers mashing on the attack button.

Thank you to everyone for all your support during the development cycle. Help finding bugs, suggestions on improving game-play, and raising your virtual pom-poms to support our efforts. 

As always, if you have any questions, comments, or suggestions, please reach out and let us know. It may be 1.0 but I'm sure there are bugs to be fixed. 

Happy Rustling!
- The DR Team

notes.title: Price Increase (for now)
notes.notes:
Happy New Year, Rustlers! 

Wanted to make everyone aware that we recently requested a price increase in the game to $4.99 (USD). This is so that we can launch the game with a discount (it's better for sales) when the time comes. 

Thank you to all our early adopters who picked up the game at the discounted price. In February we'll be exiting Early Access and launching Dungeon Rustlers with a (to be determined) launch discount. 

Happy Rustling,
Rob, Derrick, and Herb

notes.notes:
[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/31068014/09015ae9d28945508fbd9bf154d9383de83c474b.png[/img]

Iiiiiiiiiiit's - PATCH DAY!

**************************************************
* LEADER BOARDS HAVE BEEN RESET *
**************************************************

This is the final big update before we move into 1.0. From this point on it's just bug fixes with the occasional tweak. The plan (for now) is to wait until Steam's holiday sale is complete, and then we'll move out of EA. 

Thanks to everyone for your support. As always, if you've got questions, suggestions, or bugs - let us know! 

Happy Rustling.
~Rob, Derrick, and Herb

[b]New Sparkles[/b]

[list]
[*] "Ability Save - Ready" voice
[*] "Death Knight" flashy text on first DK encounter
[*] Game ending
[*] The Bandit - He'll steal your coins!
[*] Varried spawn portal colors
[*] ALL...50....LEVELS
[*] Mage & Archer do more base damage
[/list]

[b]Spit-Shined Bug Fixes[/b]

[list]
[*] Reduced some of the knight voice over frequencies
[*] No longer able to spawn on torches on level 46
[*] Bug fix for player dying during radial spawn
[*] Fix for crash on level 45
[*] Removed last 3 spawners on level 34
[*] Game would hang on the load screen if the user was offline
[*] Limit the number of times the DK shield hit notification pops up
[/list]

notes.notes:

On to level 40!  Tonight's update features a bunch of new features, levels, and bug fixes. We're getting even closer to 1.0. Thanks to all of our community members and players who've been submitting bugs, suggestions and spreading the word about DR. 

Also, shout-out to everyone who tuned in last weekend to our developer livestream on Twitch. It was an absolute blast to play DR with everyone and hang out. Keep an eye on social media for future stream dates and times. 

******************************************************
*** LEADER BOARDS HAVE BEEN RESET ***
******************************************************

[b]New Features[/b]
[list]
[*]Levels 36 - 40 are now available
[*]Save Ability Mechanic - After buying all the upgrades, you can buy the ability to have them again after dying! 
[*]Stair animation smoothed out
[*]Secret level
[*]New Enemies: Worms, Orcs, Tree Golem & Plantlings - OH MY!
[*]Boss intro text
[*]Tutorial Level
[*]Added new contributors to credits
[*]Added level number in "end of level" screen
[/list]

[b]Bug Fixes[/b]
[list]
[*]Archer was crashing when walking in acid
[*]Text wasn't being saved during a screenshot
[*]Slimes on a line pattern would remain idle after being hit
[*]Text alignment off in credits screen
[/list]

notes.title: The Mage Update - v0.2.0
notes.notes:
[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/31068014/8cf9f05b1bb104c8a1e48ca145440b0bc6c6e5f8.png[/img]

We're excited to release the second playable class for Dungeon Rustlers: The Mage! 

He's a fire-ball throwing machine who's an absolute wreaking ball once you've got all his abilities and minions upgraded. The downside? He's squishy. With only 2 hit points, you'll find yourself staying far away from enemies instead of rushing in like you did with the knight. 

[b]
============================================
===> THE LEADER BOARDS HAVE BEEN RESET <===
============================================
[/b]

That means you've got a fresh chance at climbing to the number one spot in the ranking for both the Mage AND the Knight!


In addition to adding the Mage, there are more changes in this build to check out. Read the full patch notes below.

Happy Rustling!
~Rob, Derrick, & Herb

Bug Fixes
- Potential fix for crash due to bad video memory management
- Fixed bad end-level portal spawn locations
- Music no longer starts at the beginning of a level if it's been disabled
- Level number  not resetting to level 1 after finishing level 25
- Water bubble was not observing tiering logic

Audio
- New music on level 19 & 20
- Lowered frequency of some Knight voice cues

UI Enhancements
- "your best score" Countdown timer now just pulses level timer (doesn't render big numbers)
- Stats and Leaderboard screens now support viewing different classes
- Changed default cursor to be dagger
- List boxes for scores now have functional buttons and obey keyboard & mouse scroll wheel actions


Misc
- New actors in the credits screen!
- Added additional debug logic for when games get "stuck"
- New enemy portal animation

notes.title: The Slimy Pre-Mage Patch
notes.notes:
[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/31068014/10205688424c5c7767f8adbdbc8cfa8a555ae55e.gif[/img]

What's up, rustlers? 
Tonight's patch contains fixes, new features, and a bunch of "under the covers" plumbing to get ready for next weeks big update: The Mage! 

We think you'll find some fun stuff in this patch, including a voice for the Knight, the new "Red Slime" and actually knowing when you get hit (a nice thing to know). 

As always - let us know if you hit a bug, or would like to see something tweaked. 

Happy Rustling!
~Rob, Derrick, & Herb

[list]
[b]General[/b]
[*]Added "You Died" text during death sequence
[*]Added audio queues for knight
[*]Red Slime is in the house!

[b]Bug Fixes[/b]
[*]Dying in acid no longer respawns you in a "taking damage" state
[*]After dying, previously available upgrade was still pulsing
[*]Music was playing even if toggled to off
[*]Level-end portal being rendered on pilar (unreachable) 

[b]Music[/b]
[*]Overall volume lowered
[*]Volume can be raised with PageUP and lowered with PageDOWN (slider coming soon)

[b]Camera[/b]
[*]Shakes when player takes damage
[*]Now tracks player with a smoother algorithm

[b]Death Knight[/b]
[*]Show a target on the ground of where it's going to charge to
[*]Play a sound when charging
[*]Pauses after emerging from portal
[/list]

notes.title: It's Launch Day!
notes.notes:
[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/31068014/3514b1fd3fa4886de7377bf1975a1e5542e3e2a2.png[/img]

After two(ish) months of development, Dungeon Rustlers is ready for Early Access. What does Early Access mean? It means the core game mechanics are in place, you can run the dungeon (25 out of 50 levels) with the first playable class (Knight) and it should be relatively stable. 

We've still got a LOT in store for you over the next month or so, including:

[list]
    [*]The Mage
    [*]The Archer
    [*]25 more levels
    [*]More bosses & enemies
    [*]Additional original chiptunes!
    [*]Voice-overs for every playable class (knight coming REAL soon)
[/list]

After two(ish) months of development, Dungeon Rustlers is ready for Early Access. What does Early Access mean? It means the core game mechanics are in place, you can run the dungeon (25 out of 50 levels) with the first playable class (Knight) and it should be relatively stable. 

We've still got a LOT in store for you over the next month or so, including:

    [*]The Archer
    [*]25 more levels
    [*]More bosses & enemies
    [*]Additional original chiptunes!
    [*]Voice-overs for every playable class (knight coming REAL soon)
[/list]

We wanted to get this in your hands ASAP to get your feedback on what works, and more importantly, what doesn't. Please don't hesitate to reach out to us here, on [url=https://www.reddit.com/r/dungeonrustlers/]Reddit[/url], or via our [url=http://dungeonrustlers.com/]website[/url]. 

Thank you so much for trying out Dungeon Rustlers and we hope to see your name up on the leader boards!
